svg.aria-label: Flow of the reconciler loop: check the lease margin, scan the entries and registrations, pick work by entry state, run it on a pool of sixteen, evict above high water and publish usage, then loop at once if there was progress, or wait one second doubling to the idle maximum if there was none. There is no wake ping.
svg.title: The leader's loop: scan the entries, work, wait only when idle
svg.text: The leader's loop: scan the entries, work, wait only when idle
1 Lease margin
Renewal runs on its own timer (every ttl/3). If valid_until - now < m: not the leader, wait idle-min and ask again.
2 Scan
LIST _entries/ and _tiering/proxies/; GET every entry not in its own retry back-off.
3 Pick work by state
(PUT,PENDING) replicate: CAS to (PUT,HELD,leader) first, copy, then seal. (DEL,PENDING|SEALED) roll forward. (CB,PENDING) copy back.
(op,SEALED) release. A HELD entry only if its owner departed: reap.
4 Run on a pool of 16
PUT and DEL work before CB. Each item has its own timeout; a failing item is retried after its own delay (1 s doubling to 60 s).
5 Evict and publish
Evict while above high water (own entry, byte compare). Publish usage every 10 s. Stray sweep: adopt hot objects with no entry and no cold
copy.
6 Progress?
Progress means an entry changed state or something was deleted.
yes: progress
Loop again at once: no sleep.
no progress
A live HELD entry, or evicting: wait idle-min (1 s).
Otherwise wait delay, doubling: 1, 2, 4 ... idle-max
(default 10 s). A put into an idle system waits for
the current delay. There is no wake ping.
Items are independent: one 50 GB copy blocks no other entry. Every step is idempotent and resumable, so a new leader just scans; it needs no rebuild.
The loop never spins without progress and never sleeps while there is progress. Lease renewal is not part of the loop.
